name: zinc gluconate
uses: Uses reduces the duration of the common cold reduces the severity of cold symptoms: cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, post nasal drip and/or hoarseness
otcwarn: Do not use for treatment of influenza or allergies. This product is intended only to reduce the duration of the common cold and its symptoms Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking minocycline, doxycycline, tetracycline or are on Coumadin (warfarin) therapy. Zinc treatment may inhibit the absorption of these medicines. Stop use and ask your doctor if symptoms persist more than 7 days
